notes: Shares: the prior year-end share count was taken for 2023-03-31. Income ratio: through the 10-Q for 2024-09-30 the filer tagged the ratio of TOTAL investment income to average net assets with the investment income ratio concept, so that figure was published as the income ratio; the printed net investment income ratio is declared for the eleven quarters 2022-03-31 to 2024-09-30 (from the 10-K for 2024 the tagged figure is the net ratio). Net investment income: the filer's own per-share concept is filed ahead of the dollar fact and its name contains 'NetInvestmentIncome' (income_concept_suppress). Expenses: first-quarter 10-Qs and most 10-Qs from 2024 tag expenses only as InvestmentCompanyExpenseAfterReductionOfFeeWaiverAndReimbursement (10-Q 2023-03-31: 22,295,000; printed 'Net investment income before income taxes 23,557', and total investment income 45,852 less 22,295 is 23,557), so those quarters had no expenses and the fourth quarter was published as a quarter of the year's figure (income_concept_fallback).
